dimensions.name: Governance Awareness
dimensions.rationale: The initial rules-context-loader step failed due to an API credit exhaustion error with LiteLLM/Huggingface, preventing deliberate governance context ingestion. However, the downstream current-architecture-state-generator completed and passed schema validation successfully.

dimensions.name: Causal Reasoning Depth
dimensions.rationale: The pipeline causal chain was partially broken due to the failure of the initial rule loading stage. The generator span nonetheless executed with 2594 completion tokens, demonstrating partial independent synthesis capability.

dimensions.name: Architectural Tension Analysis
dimensions.rationale: While the architectural state generator executed and validated against its target schema, the missing governance rule inputs limited comprehensive trade-off resolution against established architectural constraints.
